name: camada-cloudflare
description: Camada for Cloudflare: a Worker in your own account that sends your zone's request analytics to Camada and keeps a camada_block IP list in your WAF in sync.

CAMADA_KEY.description: Your Camada project key. Copy it from **my.camada.app → your project → Setup → Deploy on Cloudflare**.

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: A Cloudflare API token for this zone. Use the pre-filled link on the same Camada Setup page; it asks only for the permissions this Worker needs.

ZONE.description: The domain to protect, for example `example.com`. It must be a zone in this Cloudflare account.

CAMADA_URL.description: Leave as is. This is Camada's ingest URL, and you never need to change it.

HOSTS.description: `*` for every hostname in the zone, or a comma-separated list such as `www.example.com,shop.example.com`.
